blockingFindings.title: R14 parity coverage is incomplete
blockingFindings.issue: The coverage artifact marks R14 as covered, but the tests only cover selected parity points such as leaf ordering, a few schema refs, retry metric action presence, and side-effect action presence. R14 also requires preserving existing next-action envelope shape, review/gate artifact meanings, retro artifact meaning, flow state promotion, plugin hooks, and side effects; several of these are not asserted with production-observable behavior.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add spec-local assertions for the missing R14 parity surfaces, especially existing next-action envelope shape for unaffected steps, review/gate/retro artifact semantics, flow state promotion behavior, and plugin hook behavior, or split the requirement so only covered parity points remain in R14.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R14 is a must requirement and the requirement-to-test coverage artifact claims it is covered, but the actual tests do not provide corresponding coverage for multiple required parity guarantees.

advisoryFindings.title: R12 reset range assertion is narrow
advisoryFindings.improvement: For repair_and_reevaluate, also assert that steps between the recorded repairTargetStep and acceptance-review are reset consistently, not only that the repair target is in_progress and acceptance-review is pending.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The current test covers the core routing decision and prevents final-regression promotion; broader range assertions would improve confidence but are not strictly required for initial executable coverage.
